Tri Wulandari

Pengisi Suara (Voice Over) · FreelanceVoice Over Artist · Freelance

Malang, Jawa TimurMalang, East Java, Indonesia

Pengisi suara freelance asal Malang dengan warna suara hangat dan ceria. Berpengalaman mengisi suara video promosi kelas belajar AI, serta tampil sebagai MC di acara webinar dan acara offline. Mampu menulis naskah sendiri dan membawakan berbagai gaya, mulai dari narasi, iklan, e-learning, hingga karakter animasi. Freelance voice over artist based in Malang with a warm, cheerful voice. Has voiced a promotional video for an AI course and worked as an emcee at both online webinars and in-person events. Writes her own scripts and can deliver a range of styles, from narration and commercials to e-learning and animated characters.
